Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Weber Spirit II E-310 to have a gas grill option in addition to our Weber charcoal grill. Had previously purchased a big box store brand gas grill and was very disappointed with my choice. I cannot tell you how happy I am to have made the move to the Spirit grill. We have owned it for about 2 months and it has been a wonderful addition to our outdoor grilling! It's consistent, easy to use and maintains the temperature well. There is plenty of room to get all the cooking I need done and allows for both the charcoal and gas Weber grill enough room on the patio. tt is the Weber quality that makes the difference!! Couldn't be happier with our purchase!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Full disclosure: I've only had this grill for a short time, but so far I really like it.  It gets very hot and heats evenly.  Other things that I like are the easy to change drip pan, the open storage underneath (a great place to tuck the cover while I'm using the grill), the side mounted storage tank, and the folding shelf - it's really nice to be able to take up less space when not actually using the grill.  

I assembled the grill myself and, though I didn't set a timer, I think it took around 2-3 hours.  The only thing that I really had any problem with is that one of the screws that holds the from assembly together was packaged with another set of parts.  I thought that I was going to have to modify the construction until I found that little devil hiding out.  That really made no sense.  

I chose this grill because of the 10 year "bumper-to-bumper" warranty, which is head and shoulders above the more limited warranty on the other Spirit models.  I would rather have that warranty (which I hope I won't need) over a grill with an enclosed cabinet.
Results.Title: So Far, So Very Good

Photos.Caption: Sirit-II E310 with 13kg EU gas bottle poorly supported

Results.ReviewText: The propane gas bottle support is a good idea, but unfortunately it's designed for US bottles, and at 6" is not wide enough for European bottles, which have a base of 12"-12.5". The result is that the gas bottle wobbles dangerously when the grill is rolled, even on a flat surface. This design fault could be fixed so easily with a larger base plate, which should still work for US gas bottles. An additional bolt-on flat plate would also be easy.
Results.Title: Good grill, but poor gas bottle support
